SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = X.BUYER AND SYS_TYPE=X.SYS_TYPE AND BUSINESS_COND LIKE '%B%') BUYER_NAME, X.FLAG_DC, X.FLAG_PS, X.FLAG_PA, X.FLAG_FB, (X.FLAG_DC+X.FLAG_PS+X.FLAG_PA+X.FLAG_FB) AS T_FLAG, X.BUYER, X.SYS_TYPE FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'DC',1)),0) AS FLAG_DC, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'PS',1)),0) AS FLAG_PS, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'PA',1)),0) AS FLAG_PA, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'FB',1)),0) AS FLAG_FB, A.SYS_TYPE FROM KEPAVCDT A, (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND TEXT3 = 'C') B WHERE TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_fromDate} AND #{st_toDate} AND A.CLAIM_TYPE = B.CODE
AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('DC','PS')
AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('DC','PS','PA','FB')
AND (A.SYS_TYPE, A.BUYER) IN
${itm}
AND A.SYS_TYPE = #{st_sys_type}
GROUP BY A.BUYER , A.SYS_TYPE ) X ORDER BY 1
